attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names all four of its members, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the others. The corpus keeps several men of this name on other days — of Cyzicus, of Durostorum, of Trebia, the Roman, the Confessor, and the leader of a company whose members it holds as companions of Emilian; those are other entries on the same calendar and therefore other commemorations, and the English spelling here follows the corpus's own. No year, so no `dates` object. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
